links.outcome: Stability of LLM clinical reasoning when prompts vary
links.effect: None of the 32 LLMs reached human-level stability; even the best LLMs changed their reasoning when prompts varied.
links.quote: Even the best LLMs change their reasoning when prompts vary.

unlisted_practices: Coupling an image classifier's outputs to LLMs to generate structured clinical reasoning
Expert-verified gold-standard benchmarks for LLM clinical explanations

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM reasoning and stability driven by an endoscopic image classifier against expert-verified benchmarks, highlighting safety and reliability limitations without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
